title: Model manager and durable jobs
summary: Pinned model downloads (per-file SHA-256 pins, size limit, per-model source override, Hugging Face token, folder scan), a small worker-pool job queue, atomic durable JSON stores, a cancellable subprocess runner and models-folder paths. Ported formcut to formvis.
description: A model is a dict in `MODELS` with a license, optional consent key, `maxFileBytes` and `files` mapping a relative name to a URL pinned to a commit. `download` streams each file to `<name>.download`, hashes it, refuses a file with no entry in `PINNED`, deletes a mismatching file and writes a `.json` sidecar with url, sha256 and license. `jobs.submit` runs operations on a pool (429 when 8 are active; finished jobs above 100 are pruned). `durable.write_json` writes atomically with a `.bak`, `read_json` sets a damaged file aside and never reads it as empty. Routes live under /api/models and /api/jobs. The `MODELS`/`PINNED` tables are formvis data (the relight pin matches formlit). jobs.py imports `.orchestration.publish` (not seeded).
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

exports.doc: Where a model file actually is: the model folder, else the bundle.
The execution providers to hand a session: the device chosen in Preferences (Automatic takes the best one here).
Every file of the model is there: weights past the one-kilobyte floor, a config or licence file merely non-empty.
BG6: what this machine offers and which provider sessions will use.
GET /api/models: every model with id, name, license, ready, downloading, files and managedBy.
Downloads every file of a model into the models folder with a size limit; each file must match its pinned SHA-256 or it is deleted and the download fails.
POST /api/models/{model}/download: runs a tracked download job and returns 202.

Finds the helper models' files in another folder (a ComfyUI models folder, say), under any name or layout: a file is taken when its SHA-256 matches the pin of a file not yet in the model folder, and is linked in, not copied.

Queues an operation on the worker pool (429 when 8 are queued or running; finished jobs above 100 are pruned) and returns the job record.
GET /api/jobs/{job_id}: the job record without its cancel handle; 404 when unknown.
DELETE /api/jobs/{job_id}: sets the job cancel flag.
GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/file: the finished job output file; 409 until done.

exports.signature: def communicate(process, data=None, timeout=600, cancelled=lambda: False)
exports.doc: Runs process.communicate in short slices so cancelled() and the timeout (default 600 s) are honoured, killing the process on exit.
The helper model folder chosen in Preferences (used at the next engine start); empty when none was chosen.

An ONNX Runtime session for a local model (1.53.4): the best providers, and the CPU memory arena off. With it on, SAM 2.1 and U^2-Net held 2,575 MB after three runs each; off, 687 MB (a peak of 1,314 MB), for a little speed.

invariants.text: The engine is reached on loopback only, behind the app-wide LocalGuard middleware (app/core/local_guard.py, not in this corpus); routes that act (start processes, write settings or secrets, WebSockets) also check the request origin with require_local or origin_ok.
A downloaded file with no pinned SHA-256 is refused and a mismatching file is deleted; nothing unverified lands in the models folder.
Small stores are written through durable.write_json (temp file, backup, replace); a damaged store is set aside, never read as empty and saved over.
Each download is capped by the model maxFileBytes (default 2,000,000,000).
